common.errorGeneric: Kujh galat ho gia. Kirpa karke phir koshish karo.

auth.loginDescription: Apne Persona AI banking surakhia khate vich dakhal hovo.
auth.chooseMethodDescription: Chuno ke tusin apni pehchan kiven pushti karna chahunde ho.
auth.methodOtpSecurity: Uchchi surakhia — har sign-in te device-bound one-time code.
auth.methodOtpConvenience: Saanjhe ate nave devices lai suvidhajanak.
auth.methodBiometricSecurity: Mazboot surakhia — is device te Face ID ya fingerprint.
auth.methodBiometricConvenience: Wapas aunde devices te sab ton tez anubhav.
auth.methodAuthenticatorConvenience: SMS ya email ton bina offline kam karda hai.
auth.voiceWelcome: Persona AI vich ji aayan nu. Sign-in vidhi chuno, phir apna email ate password darj karo. Demo khata cards tuhadi jankari automatic bhar sakde han. Senior Mode buttons vadere karda hai ate contrast vadhaunda hai.
auth.biometricPromptTitle: Face ID ya fingerprint nal pushti karo
auth.biometricPromptDescription: Sign in pura karan lai biometric verification simulate karo.
auth.registerDescription: Apni banking gatividhi di surakhia lai Persona AI set karo.
auth.demoDescription: Pahilan ton bhare demo gahak nal Persona AI vekho.
auth.verifyOtpDescription: Sign in pura karan lai bhejia one-time code darj karo.
auth.verify2faDescription: Apni authenticator app ton 6 ankan da code darj karo.
auth.verifyWebauthnDescription: Jaari rakhani lai fingerprint, chehra ya security key vartao.
auth.otpInvalid: Oh code galat hai ya miad khatam ho gai hai.
auth.passwordMin: Password ghatt-ton-ghatt 8 akhran da hona chahida hai.

dashboard.noAlertsDescription: Sabh theek hai. Je dhian di lor hovegi tan asin suchit karange.

transactions.title: Len-den
transactions.description: Apna bhugtan itihas vekho ate khojo.
transactions.emptyDescription: Filter badlo ya statement ayat karo.
transactions.importDescription: Vishleshan lai CSV ya PDF bank statement upload karo.
transactions.simulateDescription: Adaptive Risk Engine rahi demo bhugtan chalao.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Surakhia ate khatre dian suchnavan jinhan vall dhian chahida hai.
alerts.emptyDescription: Is vele dikhaun lai koi alert nahi hai.
alerts.markedResolved: Alert hal hoia chinhit kita gia.

security.mapDescription: Vekho tusi kitthe ate kiven sign in hoe. Verevian lai marker te tap karo.
security.behaviorDescription: Persona AI tuhade aam banking pattern nu kiven samajhda hai.
security.devicesDescription: Bharoseyog devices ate sargarm sessions prabandhit karo.
security.locationsDescription: Oh thavan jitthon tusi niyamit taur te sign in karde ho.
security.eventsDescription: Tuhade khate te surakhia gatividhi di timeline.

assistant.description: Khatre, kharch, login ate agle kadam bare puchho.
assistant.errorRespond: Persona AI jawab nahi de sakia. Kirpa karke phir koshish karo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Apni profile, surakhia tarjihan, ate Adaptive Risk Engine tuhade len-den da mulankan kiven karda hai, prabandhit karo.
settings.accessibilitySaveError: Pahunchyogta tarjihan save nahi ho sakian.

accessibility.seniorModeDescription: Vadda text, vadhere contrast, voice sahaita ate ghatt dujian controls nal saral, padhan vich aasan banking anubhav. Pahili var sign in te vi eh vikalp dikh sakda hai.
accessibility.displayDescription: Text aakar, contrast ate gati apni pasand anusar adjust karo.
accessibility.largeTextDescription: Mobile te ghatt-ton-ghatt 18px ate desktop te 18–20px body text vadhao.
accessibility.highContrastDescription: Majboot text, border, badge ate button contrast. Sirf rang te nirbhar na raho.
accessibility.reducedMotionDescription: App vich animation ate transition ghatao.
accessibility.voiceLanguageDescription: Voice sahaita, Persona AI jawab, ate poori gahak interface bhasha.
accessibility.voiceResponsesDescription: Persona AI de jawab apne aap ucchi awaz vich padho.
accessibility.onboardingTitle: ਪਰਸੋਨਾ AI ਵਿੱਚ ਜੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਨੂੰ
accessibility.onboardingDescription: Sanu lagda hai ki sadian pahunchyogta suvidhavan tuhade lai labhdaiyak ho sakdian han.
accessibility.onboardingHint: Tusi is nu baad vich Settings → Pahunchyogta vich chalu kar sakde ho.
accessibility.seniorEnabledToast: Senior Mode chalu hai. Tusi is nu kade vi Settings vich badal sakde ho.
